productTitle: Hard PU Leather Mirror Compact Jewelry Box Organizer Case

scenes.prompt: A lived-in home-office corner photographed three-quarter on a 50mm lens at seated eye-level, warm mid-morning daylight raking from an unseen window at frame-left across a warm walnut writing desk. The jewelry box sits left-of-centre on a softly wrinkled oatmeal-linen runner, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: hard structured PU-leather shell, gold lock and gold carry handle, hinged lid open to reveal the small framed mirror inside the lid and the top ring-roll/earring tray, and BOTH side doors swung open showing the necklace hooks with a fine gold chain and one pair of dangle earrings hooked on them. Medium-density styling that echoes the gold hardware: a cloth-bound monograph, a brass desk clock, a stoneware cup of pens, a single dried protea in a slim vase, and a leaning thin-brass mirror returning a sliver of the room. One side door hangs a hair crooked and a faint dust mote drifts in the light beam for honest realism. Palette: warm walnut, champagne gold, oat linen, sage, cream velvet. Sharp focus, photorealistic editorial styling, single unit, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Hero functional state — lid-mirror + both necklace-hook doors open; distinct walnut writing-desk environment (not shared with other batch box).

scenes.anchor: open travel suitcase on a hotel bench

The jewelry box rests nested among the clothes, fully CLOSED and ready to travel, shown EXACTLY as the reference image: structured champagne PU-leather shell with subtle pearlescent sheen, gold front lock latched, gold carry handle standing upright as if just set down. Medium-density supporting cast that reads 'packing': a folded silk scarf, a small leather passport sleeve, a rolled belt, and a sprig of dried lavender tucked beside it. A slim brass luggage tag rests on the case. One garment fold sits slightly loose and the suitcase lining shows a faint travel crease for realism. Palette: camel, champagne, soft gold, ivory linen, dusty lavender. Sharp focus, photorealistic editorial, single unit, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Closed/travel state leaning on the carry handle + portability angle; suitcase environment unique to this box.

scenes.anchor: open lid mirror + top tray interior
scenes.prompt: A tight macro close-up on a 100mm macro-equivalent lens, shallow depth of field, focused on the open interior, inner lid mirror, and gold-tone hardware of the jewelry box shown EXACTLY as the reference image: champagne PU-leather shell edge, cream velvet ring-roll and earring grid, the small framed mirror set into the lid, and the polished gold front lock. The frame fills with the open top tray holding a small curated cluster — a fine gold chain coiled neatly, a pair of pearl studs seated in the velvet grid, and a single signet ring on the ring roll — so the buyer can read the velvet nap, the compartment edges, the mirror frame, and the gold lock mechanism in sharp detail. Soft directional daylight rakes across the velvet to show its plush pile; the gold lock and the mirror each catch a thin specular highlight. Background falls to a creamy bokeh. Natural realism: one velvet fibre catches the light slightly raised, a faint micro-scratch on the gold lock. Palette: cream velvet, champagne, warm gold, pearl, soft bokeh. Sharp macro focus on the mirror, tray contents, and hardware, photorealistic, single unit, no people, no hands, no text, no watermark, no alcohol.
scenes.justification: Mandatory macro close-up — built-in lid mirror + velvet tray contents + gold lock hardware per cornucopia (mirror is this box's signature feature).
